Given: J + K ÷ L − T × R

It means: J is the mother of K, K is the daughter of L, L is the brother of T and T is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c545041525a45397dd81ffbedcdae37c5d9cb0c4869dc3c8d1102bf1a7430666.png] 

S, J is the **Wife **of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife".
